title: YSRCP Demands Probe into DSC Exam Irregularities
summary: The YSRCP demanded a CBI probe into the DSC exam irregularities, alleging that the government had failed to address the issue despite repeated complaints. The opposition party claimed that the government had ignored the pleas of students who were denied admission due to the irregularities. The YSRCP also alleged that the government had not taken any action against those responsible for the irregularities. The opposition party demanded a thorough investigation into the matter. The government has refused to comment on the issue.
summary_points: The YSRCP demanded a CBI probe into the DSC exam irregularities
The opposition party alleged that the government had ignored repeated complaints from students
The YSRCP claimed that the government had not taken action against those responsible for the irregularities
